entities.name: The Hold
entities.description: An illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, which became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

entities.name: Riptide
entities.description: Something Pemmin survived; Pemmin is called a Riptide survivor.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A ruler who forged a swarm from the remnants of the dead to safeguard his throne.

entities.name: Urabrask the Hidden
entities.description: A leader to whom the furnace dwellers looked for guidance; he decreed that the Mirran resistance be let be.

entities.name: Mirran resistance
entities.description: A resistance force whose arrival prompted the furnace dwellers to seek Urabrask's guidance.

entities.name: Furnace dwellers
entities.description: A group who looked to Urabrask for guidance.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Grand Cenobite, who celebrates that "our glorious infection has taken hold."

events.summary: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.
events.quote: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

events.summary: Geth forged a swarm from the remnants of the dead to safeguard his throne.
events.quote: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.

events.summary: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers sought Urabrask's guidance, and he stunned them by decreeing the resistance be let be.
events.quote: His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

relations.note: They looked to Urabrask for guidance.
relations.quote: the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance

relations.note: Urabrask decreed the resistance be left alone.
relations.quote: His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."
